    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()

        for c in range(C):
            color = grid[r][c]

                continue
            cells, stack = [], [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < R and 0 <= xx < C and grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            y0, y1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            x0, x1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)

                for y in range(y0+1,y1):

    return out
''')
